segments.name: Diabetes care
segments.description: Makes and sells pen needles, syringes and safety injection devices used for insulin administration by people living with diabetes.
segments.evidence: The Company operates and reports its financial information as one segment.

revenueModel.text: Healthcare providers, pharmacies, distributors and patients pay for pen needles, syringes and safety injection devices used to administer insulin.
revenueModel.evidence: We distribute our products through a variety of channels, including retail, hospitals, pharmacies and other institutional channels.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company discontinued its patch pump program, ending its internal and external research and development investment.
changes.evidence: On November 22, 2024, the Company's Board of Directors approved a plan to discontinue internal and external investment in the research and development of the Company's patch pump program.
